Legendary opera star Irene Adler is threatening to destroy the King of Bohemia's reputation with proof of their illicit affair. The evidence? A photograph. Her ransom? The king's hand in marriage. But not only does investigating detective Sherlock Holmes already know Irene from the past, he also knows that the queen of manipulation would never resort to such a common crime. After uncovering her true ambitions, Holmes draws the cunning songstress into a well-matched game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: Thicker Than Water
programme.desc: Brand new series: Walter Presents - which showcases the best foreign language drama from around the world - features this darkly atmospheric Swedish series in which a mother reunites her three adult children and forces them to confront the family secrets buried in their past. A beautiful island in the Swedish Alandic archipelago is home to a popular lodge, run by Anna-Lisa Waldemar and her youngest son Oskar. Mysteriously, Anna-Lisa has summoned her eldest son Lasse and her daughter Jonna home - it's the first time the family have been together in years. Despite the idyllic setting, the homecoming is full of conflict, arousing old memories, resentments and secrets. No one knows why they have been brought back and all three siblings are keen for the weekend to be over. However, her children are unaware that Anna-Lisa has a hidden agenda and a plan that is set to change their lives for ever. Starring Joel Spira, Bjorn Bengtsson, Aliette Opheim, Stina Ekblad, Torkel Pettersson, Jessica Grabowsky, Saga Sarkola, Molly Nutley and Tobias Zilliacus. In Swedish with English subtitles.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. "Bayern" - "Fenerbahce"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

This documentary series showcases the ruthless beauty of this icy season, revealing the animals who thrive in their freezing conditions and the animals who simply fight for survival. When the season finally passes spring is reborn, and it is a celebration for those who managed to survive unscathed.

programme.title: Wild Vietnam
programme.desc: Travel to Vietnam's mountainous forests to discover endangered pangolins, Asian palm civets, and the golden-headed langurs of Cat Ba Island. The recently discovered Vietnamese crocodile lizard is already vulnerable to smuggling, while the critically endangered Delacour's langurs take refuge in a nature reserve. In springtime, an astonishing diversity of butterfly species congregates in the forest.

programme.title: Living Edens
programme.desc: Life and death are close companions in an Eden called Costa Rica. Nestled in the tropics of Central America, Costa Rica calls itself the land of "Pura Vida" - pure life. In a phenomenon known as the "Arribada", the arrival, olive ridley sea turtles migrate annually in massive numbers while troops of capuchin, squirrel, howler monkeys and resplendent quetzals forage in the canopy above. Below roam deadly army ants, poison dart frogs and the strongest insect on earth, the Hercules beetle.

programme.title: Wild Vietnam
programme.desc: Travel to southern Vietnam's tropical habitats, home to gibbons and playful macaques, green sea turtles, and Asian black bears. Reintroduced Siamese crocodiles roam the Bau Sau wetlands. The vast Mekong Delta boasts small-clawed otters and thousands of migrating birds, from openbill storks to Oriental darters.

programme.title: Wild Hawaii
programme.desc: Documentary series. Nicknamed The Paradise of the Pacific, Hawaii is an archipelago like no other. Its 137 islands are spread across volcanic topography, with the unstable landscapes constantly changing. Though more renowned for its pristine beaches and luscious palms, Hawaii is a wild and untamed area of brutal, natural beauty. Whether it's the unfathomably gigantic waves that crash into its reefs and shores, or the pourings of molten lava from its active volcanoes, the state encompasses all of nature's viciousness and peacefulness in one, with an abundance of delightful wildlife thriving on these unsettled islands.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: The PVS staff make sure every animal has a fighting chance. From tiny puppies and rabbits, large cows and horses, and creepy crawlies, on this episode of The Incredible Dr. Pol, it's a fun mix of, "aww," "wow," and "yuck!" The vets are out on farms calls! Dr. Pol tangles with a feisty angus bull, pregnancy checks a herd at House Dairy, and pays a visit to Clay Knob to look at a cow with a peculiar problem.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Land of the Iberian Lynx
programme.desc: Sierra Morena is a mountain range of climatic extremes. The harsh winter puts the lynxes of the Jandula River Valley to the test. Golden eagles, otters, wild boars and cormorants struggle to survive in the land of the Iberian lynx.

programme.title: Land of the Iberian Lynx
programme.desc: Spring rains bring new opportunities and hope to the land of the Iberian lynx. But for the female lynxes of the valley, it is always a challenge to raise their cubs. The series follows the lynxes in their struggle for survival, from the thrill of the hunt to the tender moments of parenting, and also witnesses their coexistence with other animals like majestic golden eagles or powerful deer.

programme.title: Underdogs
programme.desc: Ryan Reynolds assembles "The Superzeros," a team of somewhat pitiful animals with unexpectedly awesome superpowers. Forget about the cheetah's speed and the eagle's eyesight; and say hello to the invisible glass frog, the indestructible honey badger and the might of the pistol shrimp who can fire bubbles hotter than the sun.

programme.title: The Hidden Kingdoms of China
programme.desc: China is the world's third biggest country by area. It has second largest economy on the planet and the largest population. But this documentary series takes you away from China's highly-populated mega-cities and explores the more remote locations of this fascinating country. Visiting forests, jungles, mountains and grasslands, we take a rare glimpse at parts of China that usually remain unseen. We see the wildlife that live amongst the stunning beauty of the Chinese landscapes - and how they survive in often demanding situations. With golden snub-nosed monkeys, bears, bees, elephants and the legendary giant panda. The Hidden Kingdoms of China is narrated by Michelle Yeoh.

programme.title: Trials of the Wild
programme.desc: Watch a range of wild animals trying to survive in the wilderness as they migrate, hunt and defend themselves against predators and the dangers that are living alongside them. Follow animals born to fight to those designed to live in the canopy of trees as the series gives you an insight into natures greatest spectacles from around the world on land, water and air. This nature documentary is intriguing and engaging as they examine a range of species and how they survive in the most brutal environments.

programme.title: Trials of the Wild

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: The sparse African Savannah can be a fearsome place for both herds of powerful prey and the lurking predators who hunt them down. In this captivating documentary series from National Geographic, the relationship between predator and prey is closely examined, exploring the fight for survival for both sets of animals. These herds are full of powerful or agile animals, making the job of a predator to feed itself and its family a troublesome task. But the African predators are ruthless and proficient hunters, and if a herd is infiltrated, or a straggling member is targeted, they will struggle to evade these savage carnivores.

programme.title: Underdogs
programme.desc: Ryan Reynolds reveals some highly questionable parenting strategies from the animal kingdom's worst parents, the underdogs. From a goose who lays their eggs on the top of a cliff to a koala that feeds its baby poop, it's uncertain if they bad parents or just misunderstood. But no matter how bad one thinks they may be at parenting; they can't be as bad as these guys.

programme.title: Secrets of the Bees
programme.desc: National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory explores the extraordinary lives of bees — among the planet's most important animals. Over three years, special cameras opened a rare window into a single hive, revealing their hidden world. But with more than 20,000 bee species pollinating one-third of the world's food, this series uncovers their astonishing architecture and intelligence, unlocking their secrets.

programme.title: Secrets of the Bees
programme.desc: National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory returns to the honeybee sisterhood as they race to rebuild before winter. Across the planet, other bees face challenges of their own — from Dawson's bees battling for mates to honeybees facing the global spread of varroa mites. With Explorer Dr. Sammy Ramsey, Bertie explores the mounting pressures on bees and bold solutions to secure their future.

programme.title: Asia's Killer Hornets
programme.desc: Every Asian giant hornet colony starts with a single queen. Leaving one hive to start another, she'll quickly transform an empty lair into a bustling army of ruthless, efficient killing machines. These hornets will sacrifice everything to help raise legions of grubs and protect the hive at all costs.

programme.title: Wallykazam!

programme.title: Winx Club
programme.desc: Meet Bloom, a girl from Earth, who after she finds out that she is a fairy joins Alfea College on the planet Magix- a magical universe that is inhabited by fairies, witches and other mythical creatures. At Alfea College, fairy warriors from all over the universe study to improve their supernatural powers and here Bloom befriends five other fairies - Stella, the fairy of the Sun, Flora, the fairy of nature, Tecna, the fairy of technology, Musa, the fairy of music and Aisha, the fairy of waves. Together, this group of girls known as the Winx, become best friends and the force to be reckoned with as they experience incredible adventures while defending their universe from varous enemies.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Donnie's trapped in a mad scientist's lab by the Monster Mutanimals Tokka, Rahzar, Scale Tail, Antrax and Wyrm who are after Wingnut's blood. Meanwhile, Leo, Mikey and Raph try to get pizza but the shop owner is furious: they've made a mess of the place too many times! But the Turtles have never been there before! They're confused until another Tokka wrecks the place in a huge fight before exploding into ooze...and then another Tokka arrives! In the lab, Donnie plans his escape but stumbles upon a video of Rahzar who explains the Monster Mutanimals are doomed unless they find the blood of a stable mutant... and they need Donatello's help! A real-life Rahzar lunges at Donnie, who fights him off until a whole pack of Monster Mutants shows up. The other three Turtles track their Tokka to the lab but are quickly captured. Donnie can only watch as his brothers are shoved into cages... and confronted by the creator of the Monster Mutanimals, the mad scientist Jordan Perry!

His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Gullible Pants: SpongeBob is left in charge of the Krusty Krab while Mr. Krabs steps out for 15 minutes, and he is determined to make it the best-managed 15 minutes ever! Overbooked: SpongeBob's got a full day, and he's determined to do everything he's scheduled to do: help fix Mr. Krabs' telescope, go to Patrick's birthday party, and help with Sandy's science presentation. Too bad everything's scheduled for the same exact time!

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

Spuds even ENCOURAGES Raph to work out his anger and negativity through fighting, even if his family and the annoying Pigeon Pete don't get it. But although the Turtles don't see eye to eye, they must work together to stop a rampaging Rocksteady and Bebop from wrecking the city! Social media blew up with videos of the two Mutanimals going berserk, fighting each other without seeming to know what was going on around them. And all the while, doing some serious damage to the city! As the dust settles, is there someone behind the whole plot, pulling the strings?

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: All of Raph's wildest dreams are coming true in the underground Mutant Battle Arena! He gets to let loose, fighting the massive Mutanimals Bebop and Rocksteady; even the hug-loving Mondo Gecko joins in on the fun! Raph doesn't hold back, and he gets his butt kicked with a smile on his face. Not only that, he's getting some serious bling in exchange for being part of the fights - gold chains, new clothes, even his very own vehicle, the TURTLE TANK! This makes Donnie, Leo, and Mikey very suspicious, since Raph has kept everything a secret from them. But audiences love Raph, which pleases the crime boss Kitsune and her street gang, the Purple Dragons. They run the arena with the help of an obnoxious investor named Knox. programme.desc: Action con Tom Cruise nei panni del personaggio nato dalla penna di Lee Child. Reacher deve scoprire la congiura che ha portato all'arresto di una collega e fare i conti con un segreto.

programme.desc: Estate, fine anni Ottanta. Un ex tennista, deluso dalla sua mediocre carriera, diventa l'allenatore di un giovane talento timido, schiacciato dalle aspettative del padre. I due affrontano le loro paure e insicurezze.

programme.title: Emilia Perez
programme.desc: 2 Oscar, Miglior attrice e Premio della giuria a Cannes per l'originale pellicola di Jacques Audiard con Zoe Saldana, Karla Sofia Gascon, Selena Gomez.

programme.desc: Un Oscar all'epica avventura di Michael Mann con Daniel Day-Lewis. Nordamerica, 1700: durante le guerre coloniali, un indiano salva la vita alle figlie di un comandante inglese.

programme.desc: Nicholas Hoult e Toni Collette in un legal-thriller di Clint Eastwood. Durante un processo per omicidio, uno dei giurati scopre di essere l'involontario colpevole del delitto. Sconvolto dal senso di colpa, cerca di scagionare l'imputato senza rivelare la propria responsabilità.

programme.title: Soldato Jane
programme.desc: Demi Moore e Viggo Mortensen in un film di Ridley Scott. Una donna si sottopone a un addestramento massacrante agli ordini di un sadico istruttore per entrare nei Navy Seals.

programme.title: War - La guerra desiderata
programme.desc: War-dramedy di Gianni Zanasi con Edoardo Leo, Miriam Leone, Giuseppe Battiston. La guerra tra Italia e Spagna unisce le vite di un allevatore di vongole e della figlia di un politico.

programme.title: C'e' Ancora Domani
programme.desc: Esordio alla regia di Paola Cortellesi, anche protagonista, entrato nella storia del cinema italiano. Roma,1946: Delia ha accettato la sua vita ma spera in un futuro migliore per la figlia.

programme.title: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang
programme.desc: Ricatti e omicidi in un thriller con Val Kilmer, Robert Downey Jr e Michelle Monaghan. Una serie di coincidenze porta un ladro a recitare in un film. Finirà in un torbido giro.

programme.title: Il mio nome e' Nessuno
programme.desc: Terence Hill e Henry Fonda nello 'spaghetti western' restaurato di Tonino Valerii, prodotto da Sergio Leone. Un anziano pistolero affronta l'ultima impresa prima di lasciare il Far West.

programme.title: The Outfit
programme.desc: Thriller che segna l'esordio alla regia per Graham Moore, con Mark Rylance e Zoey Deutch. Chicago, anni 50: la bottega di un sarto inglese diventa l'epicentro di una faida tra gangster.

programme.title: Apollo 13
programme.desc: 2 Oscar alla pellicola di Ron Howard con Tom Hanks sulla sfortunata missione spaziale. 1970: il viaggio verso la Luna della navicella Apollo 13 viene interrotto da un'esplosione.

programme.title: Argo
programme.desc: 3 Oscar e 2 Golden Globe al thriller diretto e interpretato da Ben Affleck. Iran, 1979: uno specialista della Cia attua un geniale piano per liberare un gruppo di ostaggi.

programme.title: Mon Crime - La colpevole sono io
programme.desc: François Ozon dirige una commedia a tinte gialle nella Parigi degli anni 30. Una giovane aspirante attrice viene accusata dell'omicidio di un famoso produttore. Nel cast Isabelle Huppert.

programme.title: L'ora più buia
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Gary Oldman nel film che racconta i primi turbolenti giorni da Primo Ministro di Winston Churchill. Nel 1940, il celebre statista inglese deve affrontare l'avanzata dei nazisti e prendere decisioni drammatiche per il bene del suo paese, ma deve fare i conti con lo scettico re e con alcuni membri del suo partito che sembrano tramare contro di lui. Oscar anche al trucco. La pellicola è stato candidata anche per la sceneggiatura, scritta da Anthony McCarten che aveva firmato anche un altro fortunato biopic, “La teoria del tutto”.

programme.title: The Life of Chuck
programme.desc: Dalla penna di Stephen King, un emozionante inno alla vita diretto da Mike Flanagan. La straordinaria vita dell'uomo comune Charles Krantz (Tom Hiddleston) raccontata a ritroso.

programme.title: Il grande Lebowski
programme.desc: Commedia cult del Fratelli Coen con Jeff Bridges, John Goodman e Steve Buscemi. Drugo, un ex hippie omonimo di un ricco magnate, deve risolvere il caso di un misterioso rapimento.

programme.title: The Outfit
programme.desc: Thriller che segna l'esordio alla regia per Graham Moore, con Mark Rylance e Zoey Deutch. Chicago, anni 50: la bottega di un sarto inglese diventa l'epicentro di una faida tra gangster.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: 6 Oscar a una commedia cult degli anni 90, con Tom Hanks per la regia di Robert Zemeckis. Le incredibili vicende di un uomo ingenuo ma ottimista sullo sfondo di 30 anni di storia americana.

programme.title: Il quinto potere
programme.desc: Il fenomeno WikiLeaks nel thriller biografico con Benedict Cumberbatch. La storia della piattaforma online e del suo fondatore Julian Assange che ha fatto tremare i governi del mondo.

programme.desc: Western restaurato di Sergio Leone con James Coburn e Rod Steiger. Un fuorilegge messicano si allea con un rapinatore irlandese e si trova a combattere per la Rivoluzione di Villa e Zapata.

programme.title: Nato il quattro luglio
programme.desc: Due Oscar al biopic di Oliver Stone con Tom Cruise. La vera storia di Ron Kovic: rimasto paralizzato nell'inferno del Vietnam, torna in patria e diventa un leader pacifista.

programme.desc: Emozionante pellicola di Leonardo D'Agostini con Stefano Accorsi e Andrea Carpenzano. Per disciplinare un giovane fuoriclasse, il presidente gli affianca un insegnante privato.

programme.desc: Francesca Archibugi dirige Pierfrancesco Favino, Nanni Moretti e Kasia Smutniak, dal romanzo di Sandro Veronesi. La vita di un uomo, fra dure prove e ricordi, a partire dal suo primo amore.

programme.desc: Tom Hanks nel dramma carcerario tratto dal romanzo di Stephen King. 1935: un gigantesco uomo di colore, dotato di poteri curativi, viene condannato a morte per omicidio.

programme.desc: Varie partenze inattese e vecchie ferite portano Lorenzo a raggiungere il limite, ma un ritorno dal passatp potrebbe mettere tutto di nuovo in discussione.

programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova ci raccontano i più grandi successi del trio comico più amato d'Italia, disponibili su Sky Cinema e on demand.

programme.title: Chi ha incastrato Babbo Natale?
programme.desc: Alessandro Siani dirige e interpreta una commedia con Christian De Sica, Diletta Leotta e Angela Finocchiaro. Per far fallire Babbo Natale, un'azienda infiltra un truffatore al Polo Nord.

programme.title: Mio fratello rincorre i dinosauri
programme.desc: Alessandro Gassmann e Isabella Ragonese in una pellicola di formazione di Stefano Cipani. Un adolescente si confronta con la disabilita' del fratellino, affetto dalla sindrome di Down.

programme.title: Bla Bla Baby
programme.desc: Commedia di Fausto Brizzi con Alessandro Preziosi e Matilde Gioli. Dopo aver ingerito degli omogeneizzati contaminati, il maestro di un asilo nido inizia a decifrare le urla dei bambini.

programme.title: Megamind
programme.desc: Allegra parodia del mondo dei supereroi in un gioiello d'animazione DreamWorks. Annoiato dalla mancanza di un rivale, Megamind ne crea uno grazie al dna del nemico sconfitto, Metroman.

programme.title: The Amazing Mr. Blunden
programme.desc: Adattamento Sky Original di un classico racconto gotico di Natale. Una donna riceve dal misterioso Mr. Blunden l'offerta di lavorare come custode di una casa che potrebbe essere infestata.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania
programme.desc: Blockbuster di Halloween per tutta la famiglia. Il Conte Dracula organizza una festa per il compleanno della figlia Mavis, ma tra gli ospiti c'e' un intruso...

programme.title: Alla fine ci sei tu
programme.desc: Asa Butterfield e Maisie Williams in una storia di crescita. Un ragazzo ipocondriaco affronta le sue peggiori paure quando accetta di esaudire gli ultimi desideri di una coetanea malata.

programme.title: Troppo cattivi 2
programme.desc: Pirotecnico sequel dell'amata saga di DreamWorks Animation con i personaggi nati sulle graphic novel di Aaron Blabey. I 'Troppo Cattivi' faticano a integrarsi in società a causa della loro reputazione e vengono coinvolti in una rapina ad alto rischio orchestrata da una nuova squadra di criminali: le Troppo Cattive.

programme.title: Il Grinch
programme.desc: Animazione campione d'incassi targata Illumination tratta dal racconto del Dr. Seuss. Lo scontroso mostriciattolo verde odia lo spirito del Natale ed elabora un piano per sabotare la festa.

programme.title: Bla Bla Baby
programme.desc: Commedia di Fausto Brizzi con Alessandro Preziosi e Matilde Gioli. Dopo aver ingerito degli omogeneizzati contaminati, il maestro di un asilo nido inizia a decifrare le urla dei bambini.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale

programme.title: The Portable Door
programme.desc: Dai libri fantasy di Tom Hol, film Sky Original con Christoph Waltz, Sam Neill e Patrick Gibson. Londra: due tirocinanti scoprono che i loro capi vogliono sabotare il mondo della magia.

programme.title: Bambi - Una vita nei boschi
programme.desc: Un piccolo cerbiatto di nome Bambi è appena venuto al mondo. Con l'aiuto dei suoi amici, Bambi vivrà ogni tipo di avventura che lo preparerà ad assumere il suo ruolo di principe della foresta.

programme.title: I viaggiatori
programme.desc: Avventuroso viaggio nel tempo targato Sky Original. Un gruppo di adolescenti alla ricerca di un fratello scomparso, viene catapultato nella Roma del 1939 sull'orlo del conflitto mondiale.

programme.title: Z La formica
programme.desc: Spettacolari avventure in un gioiello d'animazione della Dreamworks. Per fare colpo sulla Principessa Bala, Z si finge formica-soldato e si trova coinvolto nella guerra contro le termiti.

programme.title: Lassie torna a casa
programme.desc: Avventuroso reboot del film datato 1943, che riporta sullo schermo il cane più famoso del cinema. Finito in una famiglia che non esita a maltrattarlo, Lassie riesce a scappare e affronta molti pericoli pur di ricongiungersi con il suo affezionato padrone Florian.

programme.title: Madagascar
programme.desc: Un gioiello di animazione diventato un classico. Un leone, una giraffa, un ippopotamo e una zebra evadono dallo zoo di New York per vivere rocambolesche avventure nella giungla.

programme.desc: Oscar 2002 all'animazione che ha rivoluzionato il mondo delle favole. Un orco verde, scorbutico ma dal cuore buono, deve liberare una principessa che nasconde un segreto.

programme.title: Wallace & Gromit: La maledizione del coniglio mannaro
programme.desc: Oscar come miglior film d'animazione per una strabiliante avventura. Wallace e Gromit devono fermare un enorme e vorace coniglio che sta per rovinare la fiera dell'ortaggio gigante (GBR 2005).

programme.title: Nogomet: Liga Prvaka
programme.desc: Sažetak 1/8 Finala. Pogledajte najzanimljivije trenutke utakmica svih faza najvećeg klupskog nogometnog natjecanja u Europi.

programme.title: Nfl Super Bowl
programme.desc: Super Bowl 60. sezone NFL-a igra se 8. veljače u 23:15. Poluvremenski show donosi Bad Bunny.

programme.title: Nogomet – Liga Prvaka: Tottenham – Atletico Madrid
programme.desc: Atletico Madrid zabio je tri gola do 15. minute u prvoj utakmici osmine finala Lige prvaka protiv Tottenham Hotspura, a krajnji rezultat bio je 5:2. Spursi love čudo pred domaćim navijačima.

programme.title: Košarka – Aba Liga: Fmp – Zadar
programme.desc: Utakmica četvrtog kola play-out faze natjecanja ABA lige donosi susret FMP Beograda i KK Zadra.

programme.title: Rukomet – Europska Liga: Kristianstad – Nexe
programme.desc: IFK Kristianstad i Nexe Našice na rasporedu imaju prvi međusobni susret u play-offu Europske rukometne lige.

programme.title: Nogomet – Francuska Liga: Toulouse – Lorient
programme.desc: U utakmici 27. kola Ligue 1 Toulouse dočekuje Lorient na travnjaku Stadiona de Toulouse.

programme.title: Nogomet – Premier League: Everton – Chelsea
programme.desc: Nakon ispadanja iz Lige prvaka i poraza od Newcastlea u prošlom kolu, Chelsea se nada vratiti u pobjednički niz gostovanjem kod Evertona u 31. kolu Premier League.

programme.title: Nogomet – Talijanska Liga: Atalanta – Verona
programme.desc: Nakon teških poraza u Ligi prvaka, Atalanta u 30. kolu Serie A dočekuje protivnika s posljednjeg mjesta na tablici Hellas Veronu.

programme.title: Nogomet – Španjolska Liga: Athletic Bilbao – Betis
programme.desc: Nakon niza utakmica bez pobjeda u ligi, Real Betis nada se ostvariti pobjedu protiv Athletic Bilbaa na travnjaku stadiona San Mamés u utakmici 29. kola LaLige.
